name: xTool F2 Ultra
tagline: 60W MOPA fiber + 40W diode under one cover: color metal marking with a bigger bed than F1 Ultra
tldr: xTool's flagship desktop dual laser: 60W MOPA fiber for color and deep metal marking, plus a 40W diode for wood and leather, in an enclosed 220 × 220 mm machine. Fast and precise, but priced for small businesses, not hobby use.
mainObjective: High-speed compact metal marking plus bonus diode for wood & leather

priceRange.note: Official xTool store, Oct 2026: $4,299 MOPA-only, $5,299 dual laser, up to $6,969 for the deluxe bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: 60W MOPA marks colors, deep engraves and cuts thin brass or stainless steel
Enclosed cover with eye protection and fire stop: safer in a shared workspace than open galvo markers
Two 48 MP cameras for precise placement on small parts and jewelry
40W diode in the same machine handles wood, leather and coated materials
cons: Expensive: the dual-laser version starts above $5,000
220 × 220 mm bed is made for small parts, not signs or sheet goods
Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or thick wood cutting
beginnerNotes: This profile covers xTool F2 Ultra. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Use conveyor for dog tags and flat blanks. Keep fiber and diode settings libraries separate: power curves are not interchangeable.
primaryUse: Professional compact dual-laser for high-speed metal marking and small organic-material engraving.

faq.question: F2 Ultra vs F1 Ultra: worth upgrading?
faq.answer: The F2 Ultra moves from a 20W fiber to a 60W MOPA, which adds color marking, deeper engraving and thin-metal cutting, plus a larger 220 × 220 mm area and dual cameras. If you only do simple black marks on metal, a discounted F1 Ultra still does the job for much less.

faq.question: Can the F2 Ultra cut metal?
faq.answer: Only thin sheet: xTool shows brass and stainless steel cut-outs with the 60W MOPA. Thicker metal needs an industrial fiber cutter.

moduleSystem.headline: High-power dual laser (MOPA fiber + diode)
moduleSystem.description: F2 Ultra pairs MOPA fiber for metal/color marking with a 40W-class diode for organics. Dual-source hybrid, not interchangeable wattage tiers.

editorialDepth.advantages: The F2 Ultra makes sense for a business that marks metal every day: color MOPA results, galvo speed, camera placement and an enclosure in one desktop unit. The diode turns it into a two-in-one for wood and leather goods.
editorialDepth.limitations: Too much machine for occasional gifts, and the small bed rules out large items. Buyers who only need wood and leather get more for their money from an enclosed diode or a CO₂ laser.
